news.headline: Central Florida Wed Nov 25 afternoon: NWS Melbourne Flood Watch through Thu 1 AM, Coastal Flood Advisory through Thu 11 AM, River Flood Warning and Rip Current Statement through Fri 1 AM, and Small Craft Advisory through Thu 7 PM remain in effect — Melbourne at 4 PM light rain 69°F, rain chance 83% easing tonight, Thu high near 72°F / low 54°F

Florida housing Oct 2026 — Florida Realtors Nov 16: existing single-family closed sales fell 10.1% year over year to 19,049, the third straight monthly decline, while the statewide median rose 2.2% to $420,000; condo-townhouse sales fell 5% to 6,862 with median down 3.3% to $290,000, and new pending single-family sales dropped 15.7% — next statewide release Dec 16

Florida construction starts Wed Nov 25 — McDowell Housing Partners closed $35.9 million in financing and began construction on Clara Landings, an 84-unit affordable housing development at 4470 Santa Barbara Blvd in Naples, financed with Florida Housing Finance Corporation tax-exempt bonds, 4% Low-Income Housing Tax Credits and $10 million in CDBG-DR funds; completion expected Spring 2028

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31, 2026 — the edition in effect on the permit application date governs the work for the life of the permit; the 2026 codes are based on the 2024 International Codes and include the 2023 National Electrical Code, and Miami-Dade portal submissions after 4 PM Dec 30 will be subject to the 2026 edition

Copper in a bear market Wed Nov 25 — WSJ: LME copper fell 2% Wednesday to $11,646 a metric ton, its lowest since December last year, on track for a 17% monthly decline, with spot near $5.31/lb; ScrapMonster Nov 25 reported North American copper scrap fell 25 cents/lb on Nov 24 for #1 Bare Bright, #1 and #2 Wire and Tubing, and #3 Light Copper, while China's Yangshan import premium stayed near record levels around $450/ton — ACHR News, updated Nov 24: HVAC M&A EBITDA multiples have fallen from their 2021-2023 highs, though private equity remains active and smaller contractors have not seen the same decline
news.source: Wall Street Journal / ScrapMonster / ACHR News

news.headline: Florida Live Local Act — Sarasota County voted 3-2 on Nov 17 not to appeal Circuit Judge Hunter Carroll's Nov 4 ruling ordering the county to process D.R. Horton's Live Local application for 864 apartments beside Celery Fields, after Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier filed an amicus brief backing the developer's reading of the law; the county directed its attorney to resolve the other Live Local lawsuits and negotiate over the site

Inflation rose Wed Nov 25 — BEA: October PCE price index rose 0.3% in the month and 3.8% year over year, up from 3.6% in September, with core PCE up 3.3% year over year from 3.1%, its highest since November 2023; markets priced about a 98% chance of a quarter-point Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting from the current 3.75%-4.00% range
news.source: Investor's Business Daily / U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis

news.headline: Wall Street pares steep losses Wed afternoon Nov 25 — after falling more than 1,100 points in the morning, the Dow reversed to up more than 270 points, or 0.6%, in midafternoon trading, with the Nasdaq down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.2% near 7,182 as AI stocks bounced off morning lows; Bankrate put the average 30-year fixed mortgage at 7.34% Wednesday, and U.S. markets are closed Thu for Thanksgiving

NBA — Orlando Magic remain atop NBA Cup East Group A at 3-1 despite Tue Nov 24's 104-86 loss to Detroit; Miami Heat (10-6), leaders of Cup East Group B at 2-0 on a seven-game win streak, visit the Philadelphia 76ers (14-4) Wed Nov 25 at 5 PM ET on ESPN in NBA Cup play, with Joel Embiid doubtful (illness) and Giannis Antetokounmpo questionable for Miami
news.source: Sports Illustrated / Sixers Wire / USA Today

news.headline: NFL — all three Florida teams lost Sun Nov 22: Detroit Lions beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 31-21, Buffalo Bills beat the Miami Dolphins 26-9, and New York Giants beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 23-18; Week ahead: Jets at Dolphins and Titans at Jaguars Sun Nov 29 at 1 PM ET, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 at 8:15 PM ET
